name: dsh-codex-login
description: Sign in with ChatGPT (Codex) for DeepSeek Harness. dsh 0.2.2 ships the openai-codex provider and registers its OAuth flow, but nothing consumes authorization.list(), so the provider is unreachable from the GUI — it is OAuth-only and the Models page only offers an API key field. This plugin adds the missing surface: POST /codex-login/start returns a device code immediately, GET /codex-login/status reports progress, and a codex_login tool lets an agent walk the user through it. The credential lands in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml exactly as the built-in flow would.
